source_context:
1: ---
     2: # Zeroclaw workspace overlay — mirrors operator-supplied files from the
     3: # control-plane staging tree onto the agent host under
     4: # `workspace_dest_root` (declared in zeroclaw/manifest.yaml).
     5: #
     6: # Structurally identical to openclaw/playbooks/workspace.yaml — only
     7: # the manifest-declared destination changes. The zeroclaw workspace
     8: # dir is the same path holding the canonical memory tree, so an
     9: # operator drop sits alongside memory MD files.
    10: #
    11: # Inputs (extravars):
    12: #   - agent_name:          unix user that owns the zeroclaw install
    13: #   - staging_dir:         control-machine path; staged copies of the
    14: #                          enumerated workspace files (see
    15: #                          core/workspace_sync.py). Files live at
    16: #                          `<staging_dir>/<item.rel>`.
    17: #   - workspace_dest_root: absolute path under the agent's home, e.g.
    18: #                          `/home/<agent_name>/.zeroclaw/workspace`.
    19: #                          Sourced from manifest.features.workspace_overlay
    20: #                          via extravar (S2 iter-2). Do NOT hardcode the
    21: #                          suffix here — the manifest is the single source.
    22: #   - workspace_files:     list of `{rel, src, mode, owner, group}` dicts;
    23: #                          the Python enumerator carries local mode bits
    24: #                          and floors secret-pattern files to 0600
    25: #                          (W13 iter-1, U20).
    26: #
    27: # Why no `ansible_user_dir` (B1 iter-3): `become_user` does NOT re-run
    28: # the `setup` module, so `ansible_user_dir` keeps the SSH-connecting
    29: # user's home (`/home/xclm`), not the agent user's. The assert task
    30: # below pins the rendered `workspace_dest_root` to the
    31: # `/home/{{ agent_name }}/...` prefix.
    32: - hosts: all
    33:   become: yes
    34:   become_user: "{{ agent_name }}"
    35:   gather_facts: false
    36:   tasks:
    37:     - name: Assert agent_name matches the safe slug pattern
    38:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    39:         that:
    40:           - agent_name is string
    41:           - agent_name is match('^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$')
    42:         fail_msg: "Invalid agent_name: {{ agent_name | default('<unset>') }}"
    43:         quiet: true
    44: 
    45:     - name: Assert workspace_dest_root is under /home/{{ agent_name }}/
    46:       # B1 iter-3 backstop: the manifest is the source of truth, but a
    47:       # tampered extravar pointing at e.g. `/etc/zeroclaw` must bail
    48:       # before any copy task runs.
    49:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    50:         that:
    51:           - workspace_dest_root is string
    52:           - workspace_dest_root | length > 0
    53:           - workspace_dest_root.startswith('/home/' ~ agent_name ~ '/')
    54:         fail_msg: >-
    55:           workspace_dest_root must start with `/home/{{ agent_name }}/`
    56:           (got '{{ workspace_dest_root | default('<unset>') }}')
    57:         quiet: true
    58: 
    59:     - name: Assert staging_dir is a non-empty absolute path under the clawrium staging tree
    60:       # Defense-in-depth: the Python entry point always passes a
    61:       # `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory` path under
    62:       # `${clawrium_config}/staging/workspace/`, so a tampered inventory
    63:       # pointing at `/etc` or `/root` would not match the expected
    64:       # substring and the playbook bails before any `copy` task runs.
    65:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    66:         that:
    67:           - staging_dir is string
    68:           - staging_dir | length > 0
    69:           - staging_dir.startswith('/')
    70:           - "'/clawrium/staging/workspace/' in staging_dir"
    71:         fail_msg: >-
    72:           staging_dir must be an absolute path under
    73:           `${clawrium_config}/staging/workspace/` (got '{{ staging_dir }}')
    74:         quiet: true
    75: 
    76:     - name: Assert workspace_files is a list
    77:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    78:         that:
    79:           - workspace_files is iterable
    80:           - workspace_files is not string
    81:           - workspace_files is not mapping
    82:         fail_msg: "workspace_files must be a list"
    83:         quiet: true
    84: 
    85:     - name: Assert each workspace file entry is a relative path
    86:       # W12 iter-2 belt-and-suspenders: even if Python enumeration filters
    87:       # symlinks/traversal, this re-asserts inside the playbook so a future
    88:       # bypass cannot land hostile paths on host.
    89:       ansible.builtin.assert:
    90:         that:
    91:           - item.rel is string
    92:           - item.rel | length > 0
    93:           - not item.rel.startswith('/')
    94:           - "'..' not in (item.rel.split('/'))"
    95:         fail_msg: >-
    96:           workspace file entry has unsafe rel: '{{ item.rel | default('<unset>') }}'
    97:         quiet: true
    98:       loop: "{{ workspace_files }}"
    99:       loop_control:
   100:         label: "{{ item.rel | default('<unset>') }}"
   101: 
   102:     - name: Ensure workspace destination root exists
   103:       ansible.builtin.file:
   104:         path: "{{ workspace_dest_root }}"
   105:         state: directory
   106:         owner: "{{ agent_name }}"
   107:         group: "{{ agent_name }}"
   108:         mode: "0755"
   109: 
   110:     - name: Ensure parent directories exist for each workspace file
   111:       # The `dirname` is computed Python-side too, but doing it here keeps
   112:       # the playbook self-contained against a stripped extravar payload.
   113:       ansible.builtin.file:
   114:         path: "{{ workspace_dest_root }}/{{ item.rel | dirname }}"
   115:         state: directory
   116:         owner: "{{ agent_name }}"
   117:         group: "{{ agent_name }}"
   118:         mode: "0755"
   119:       loop: "{{ workspace_files }}"
   120:       loop_control:
   121:         label: "{{ item.rel }}"
   122:       when: item.rel | dirname | length > 0
   123: 
   124:     - name: Push each workspace file onto the host
   125:       # `copy` writes to a tempfile in the dest dir and renames atomically.
   126:       # `follow: no` is the W12 iter-2 / W18 iter-2 symlink defense: even
   127:       # though Python enumerates with `os.path.islink` filtering and stages
   128:       # via `shutil.copy2` into a managed `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory`,
   129:       # the playbook re-asserts the no-symlink invariant at the copy boundary.
   130:       ansible.builtin.copy:
   131:         src: "{{ staging_dir }}/{{ item.rel }}"
   132:         dest: "{{ workspace_dest_root }}/{{ item.rel }}"
   133:         owner: "{{ agent_name }}"
   134:         group: "{{ agent_name }}"
   135:         mode: "{{ item.mode }}"
   136:         follow: no
   137:       loop: "{{ workspace_files }}"
   138:       loop_control:
   139:         label: "{{ item.rel }}"
